request.question: Verify the body's exact counterexample/conclusion: using a Hannan-consistent action selection algorithm directly on observed payoff does not ensure simultaneous-move MCTS convergence; what joint-action averaging or unbiased payoff observations assumption restores it? This will qualify a finite small matrix endgame solver, not claim it already converges within 300 ms.

verification.paraphrase_ko: Hannan consistency만으로 일반 SM-MCTS 수렴을 보장하지 못하는 반례가 있다. 공동 행동별 보상의 평균을 사용하는 SM-MCTS-A 또는 별도 unbiased-payoff-observation 조건과 탐험 조건을 구분해야 한다.
